message.content:
Assuming `log` is the natural logarithm:

\[
\int -3\log(x**3)\,dx
\]

Since \(\log(x**3)=3\log(x)\),

\[
\int -3\log(x**3)\,dx=\int -9\log(x)\,dx
\]

Using \(\int \log(x)\,dx = x\log(x)-x\),

\[
\int -9\log(x)\,dx=-9\*(x\log(x)-x)+C
\]

\[
=-9*x\log(x)+9*x+C
\]

<answer>-9*x*log(x) + 9*x + C</answer>
